audit_items.proof_trace: Gas cap enforcement is correctly active post-Fusaka. GasLimitCapTxValidator is registered for all five mainnet transaction types (Legacy, AccessList, EIP1559, Blob, SetCode) in TxValidator constructor. Osaka fork (which Fusaka maps to) enables IsEip7825Enabled=true, activating the 16,777,216 gas cap. DepositTx (0x7E) correctly excluded as Optimism-specific.
